


```{python}
import numpy as np
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
```


```{python}
P = np.array([[0.9, 0.1],
              [0.2, 0.8]])
pi_0 = np.array([0.5, 0.5])
```


```{python}
pi_1 = pi_0 @ P
```


```{python}
Pi = np.zeros((20,2))
```


```{python}
Pi[0, :] = pi_1
```


```{python}
for i in range(20):
    Pi[i] = pi_0 @ np.linalg.matrix_power(P, i)
print
```


```{python}
p = 0.1
q = 0.2
pi = (q/(p + q), p/(p + q))
print(pi)
```


```{python}
def update(frame):
    for bar, altura in zip(bars, Pi[frame, :]):
        bar.set_height(altura)
    title.set_text(f"Distribución de X_{frame + 1}")

    return (*bars, title)
```


```{python}
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize = (4, 4))
bars = ax.bar(["0", "1"], Pi[0, :],
              color = "dodgerblue")
ax.set_ylim(0, 1)
ax.set_ylabel("Probabilidad")
title = ax.set_title(r"Distribución de $X_{1}$")
```


```{python}
import matplotlib.animation as animation

ani = animation.FuncAnimation(fig = fig,
                              func = update,
                              frames = 20,
                              interval = 500)
```


```{python}
from IPython.display import HTML

HTML(ani.to_jshtml())
```
